create_bucket_sort_task: create a BucketSort task with a custom vocab_size to generate sorted token sequences
sample_batch_sorted_tokens: sample a batch of random token strings and their sorted outputs using a JAX PRNG key
get_input_size: get the input size for the BucketSort task which equals the vocab_size
get_output_size: get the output size for the BucketSort task which equals the vocab_size
compute_output_length: compute the output length for a given input length which returns the same length
